items.title: How to Manage Custom Icons on Web and Mobile Maps
items.summary: Learn how to manage custom icons for web and mobile maps. Combine multiple icon sets on a single map, reuse them globally, and upload SVG or PNG formats.
items.author: MapTiler (Dalibor Janak)

items.title: A New Approach to Enterprise Routing: Join the MapTiler Beta
items.summary: Manage complex fleet logistics with MapTiler's Enterprise Routing API. Get precise terrain data and predictable pricing. Join our global beta today.
items.author: MapTiler (Jachym Cepicky)

items.title: Boost User Engagement with GeoSplats
items.summary: Build interactive, photorealistic 3D world models by putting your splats on maps. Start georeferencing splats today.
items.author: MapTiler (Jaroslav Polacek)

items.title: Add Geocoding Controls Quickly to JavaScript Maps
items.summary: Place searching controls are available on all JavaScript maps, so there is no need to rely on Svelte anymore.
items.author: MapTiler (Dominik Zochowski)

items.title: Geocoding with Predictable Pricing
items.summary: Geocoding Sessions to make sure your bills are more predictable, counting a user loading a map, exploring it, and searching for locations as a single action.
items.author: MapTiler (Jachym Cepicky)

items.title: Animated Routes on Maps
items.summary: Animated routes with dynamic cameras that follow a trail, flight, or road trip allow you to tell a story about where users are going and what they will see.
items.author: MapTiler (Dominik Zochowski)

items.title: Tuning Geocoding Searches: A Guide to Better Results
items.summary: Find out how to use the underlying logic of the geocoder and available parameters to fine-tune the search results for specific needs.
items.author: MapTiler (Jachym Cepicky)

items.title: A New Map of Japan
items.summary: We have a new, clean, modern map of Japan that uses its specific cartographic conventions. Built with a unique blend of official GSI data and MapTiler’s premium Planet-V4 mapping dataset.
items.author: MapTiler (Nicolas Bozon)

items.title: Blend Your Custom Imagery into Global Satellite Maps
items.summary: MapTiler Server 4.8 has been released, allowing you to blend your own aerial or drone imagery into global satellite maps using a visual editor; deploy rapidly to Apple computers with the macOS Installer. Plus is has updated geocoding with world views.
items.author: MapTiler (Jakub Bican)

items.title: May Updates: Interactive 3D models and a New Map of Japan
items.summary: A huge improvement to 3D models in our SDK enables great interactivity. We have a new, clean, modern map of Japan using their specific cartographic conventions.
items.author: MapTiler (Tom Armitage)

items.title: OpenMapTiles 3.16: Transportation Layer Improvements and Style Enhancements
items.summary: Version 3.16 offers improved road connections and dark-mode maps. Thanks to all the Open-source contributors who helped update it.
items.author: MapTiler (Tomas Pohanka)

items.title: New Powerful Online Georeferencing
items.summary: Instantly transform raw images into fully georeferenced map tiles ready to publish with the new online georeferencer. Position floor plans, architectural drawings, and drone imagery using an intuitive web interface.
items.author: MapTiler (Jaroslav Polacek)

items.title: April Updates: Professional Grids for Maps and a Huge Satellite Imagery Refresh
items.summary: Create professional maps with gridlines, and a major update to our Satellite layer, adding up-to-date high-resolution imagery for Scandinavia and the US.
items.author: MapTiler (Tom Armitage)

items.title: Ocean: The Map for Maritime Navigation
items.summary: Uncover the depths of 71% of Earth with our Ocean map, which visualizes the seafloor's richness by revealing ridges, basins, and trenches in stunning detail.
items.author: MapTiler (Petra Duriancikova)

items.title: March Updates: New Styles & Refined French Addressing
items.summary: We’ve made a major update to our Map styles, including Satellite, Backdrop, and Aquarelle. We’ve also added over 650,000 new addresses, largely in rural areas of France, to our search and location services.
items.author: MapTiler (Tom Armitage)

items.title: Topo Map: Precision in Every Terrain and Elevation
items.summary: Empower critical operations with Topo: high-resolution terrain data, vector performance, and multilingual support via API or on-prem. Precision for every mission.
items.author: MapTiler (Petra Duriancikova)

items.title: Better Postal Code Coverage and Accuracy Across the US and Canada
items.summary: Our geocoding in North America just got a massive upgrade. Get 10x more postal codes in Canada and much more accurate US searches to power your logistics, checkouts, and other apps.
items.author: MapTiler (Jachym Cepicky)

items.title: The Best Hiking, Biking, & Skiing Maps We've Ever Made
items.summary: Outdoor and Winter map styles for hiking, biking, skiing, and all outdoor and winter sports now have more detail and clearer cartography. The best maps for making outdoor or activity tracking apps and websites.
items.author: MapTiler (Nicolas Bozon)

items.title: Custom Map Controls to Match your Design
items.summary: Fully control styling, behavior, and interaction logic of custom map controls. With MapTiler SDK JS, using native HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, you can fully control the map UI with declarative or programmatic APIs.
items.author: MapTiler (Dominik Zochowski)

items.title: Multidirectional Hillshades and Terrain Color Ramps for Web Maps
items.summary: Style terrain by altitude with a new color relief functionality and advanced hillshade methods. Available in both Customize and the latest SDK.
items.author: MapTiler (Dalibor Janak)

items.title: Search US Addresses with Suites, Floors, Units, and More
items.summary: Get precise results for searches on US addresses. Enhanced preprocessing of our Search now handles "messy" inputs such as floors, suites, and apartments.
items.author: MapTiler (Jachym Cepicky)

items.title: GeoSplats Update: Superb Detail at Any Zoom Level With the New LoDs
items.summary: GeoSplats, MapTiler’s photo-realistic 3D models have been upgraded with new Levels of Detail (LoDs). These give a significant performance boost and make advanced models usable on less powerful devices.
items.author: MapTiler (Jaroslav Polacek)

items.title: Better search for POIs and landforms
items.summary: Our latest Geocoding update adds 3.8M+ new business POIs and improves search accuracy for natural landforms and cross-border features; all with zero integration changes.
items.author: MapTiler (Jachym Cepicky)

items.title: Dataviz: the perfect map style for dashboards
items.summary: The Dataviz map style is now easier to integrate into dashboards and interactive visualizations with its simple layer hierarchy and reliable base data.
items.author: MapTiler (Eva Jelinkova)

items.title: Search upgrade: Locate buildings with a “/” in the name
items.summary: Searches for locations with a slash in them are now more accurate with MapTiler's geocoding service. We account for local differences in how they are used around the world.
items.author: MapTiler (Jachym Cepicky)

items.title: OpenStreetMap Dark: The community favorite, now optimized for the night
items.summary: Experience the classic OpenStreetMap style in a dark mode. It offers cartography with high-contrast icons, colours, and typography to ensure perfect clarity against the dark background.
items.author: MapTiler (Petra Duriancikova)

items.title: Style individual buildings with our new tileset
items.summary: Upgrade your local cartography with the Buildings tileset: a high-detail expansion for the latest map v4 styles featuring stable IDs, 3D geometry, and precise entrance points.
items.author: MapTiler (Jachym Cepicky)

items.title: Turn GeoPDFs into interactive maps
items.summary: Transforming your static engineering drawings or scanned maps into interactive map layers is now easier than ever. Upload georeferenced PDFs directly to the Cloud.
items.author: MapTiler (Jaroslav Polacek)

items.title: GeoCamp/SotMes 2025: Spanish OSGeo & OpenStreetMap community conference
items.summary: Highlights of GeoCamp & SotM Spain 2025: from DuckDB and MapTiler innovations to a discussion with geospatial community and international experts.
items.author: MapTiler (Wladimir Szczerban)

items.title: Elevate your globe maps with custom space and halo
items.summary: Elevate your globe visualizations with new spacebox and halo features. Customize atmospheric effects and star backgrounds easily in Map Designer or the SDK.
items.author: MapTiler (Dalibor Janak)

items.title: Regional extracts for satellite imagery: Download only what you need
items.summary: Save disk space: Regional extracts are now available for Satellite imagery. Select specific continents, countries, or cities to optimize your hosting.
items.author: MapTiler (Jakub Bican)

items.title: Landscape: A map that inspires journeys & stories
items.summary: The new Landscape map style: an artistic canvas for journeys. With unique hand-drawn hillshading and adaptive clarity, it brings your data stories to life.
items.author: MapTiler (Nicolas Bozon)

items.title: The ultimate map canvas: introducing our Base style
items.summary: The new Base map style: the ultimate map canvas for data visualization. Clean, unobtrusive, and AI-ready, it’s the perfect backdrop for your data.
items.author: MapTiler (Jachym Cepicky)

items.title: 5 years of Innovation, Product news, & a Foundation Launch!
items.summary: MapTiler's first user conference Connect 25 was a great success. Launching GeoSplats, Mobile Mapping SDKs, next-generation maps, Open Foundation, and more.
items.author: MapTiler (Tom Armitage)

items.title: A new generation of street map
items.summary: Introducing the new MapTiler Streets map. Features include localized shields, last-mile detail, Dark mode, and enhanced transit networks for navigation.
items.author: MapTiler (Petra Duriancikova)

items.title: MapTiler for a good cause: Light Up Czechia
items.summary: MapTiler supports Light Up Czechia by providing an interactive map that visualizes every donation.
items.author: MapTiler (Barbora Soldatova)

items.title: Map rasterization on all platforms
items.summary: On-premises rasterization is now available on all platforms with Server! Serve modern maps from any operating system to legacy systems that are up to 20 years old.
items.author: MapTiler (Jakub Bican)

items.title: On-prem maps in three simple steps
items.summary: MapTiler On-Prem has made it easy to get software to serve the maps you host on your own infrastructure.
items.author: MapTiler (Jakub Bican)

items.title: New generation of MapTiler maps
items.summary: Three new map styles with refreshed cartography with denser data across zoom levels are now avaiable for public testing.
items.author: MapTiler (Jachym Cepicky)

items.title: New aerial imagery of Lithuania
items.summary: Fresh 20 cm/px imagery from 2020–2024 is now available in the MapTiler satellite map.
items.author: MapTiler (Petra Duriancikova)

items.title: Clean up your GPS tracks or any other spatial data
items.summary: Use the vector data editor to simplify or smooth lines and polygons on your maps to make them look cleaner and load faster.
items.author: MapTiler (Martin Tesar)

items.title: Updated aerial imagery of Spain
items.summary: Spain has newly processed aerial imagery added to the MapTiler Satellite map.
items.author: MapTiler (Petra Duriancikova)

items.title: High-resolution satellite imagery of Estonia
items.summary: Fresh, high-quality aerial imagery of Estonia is now available in the MapTiler satellite map.
items.author: MapTiler (Petra Duriancikova)

items.title: Join us at MapTiler Connect 25 in October
items.summary: Save the date for MapTiler Connect 25, our first ever user conference! October 21st
items.author: MapTiler (Tom Armitage)

items.title: Detailed aerial imagery of the Netherlands
items.summary: A fresh set of 2024 aerial images has just been added to our satellite map, covering the Netherlands in remarkable clarity. The new data comes at 7.5 cm/px resolution, capturing the country’s unique mix of landscapes and cities with impressive precision.
items.author: MapTiler (Petra Duriancikova)

items.title: Get the elevation of anywhere on Earth
items.summary: The Elevation API can be used to return the height above sea-level for any given location, or batch of locations
items.author: MapTiler (Dalibor Janak)

items.title: New high-resolution satellite map of Prague
items.summary: The satellite map of Prague has just been updated with brand-new aerial imagery from 2024, now available in stunning 5 cm/px resolution.
items.author: MapTiler (Petra Duriancikova)

items.title: Next-gen multithread processing in Engine 14.1
items.summary: Convert your data into map tiles extremely fast and reliably with our next-gen multithread technology in MapTiler Engine 14.1.
items.author: MapTiler (Jaroslav Polacek)

items.title: Upload spatial data easily with our new JavaScript library
items.summary: A TypeScript & JavaScript library for handling large file uploads with multipart support and progress tracking. The Upload JS provides a simple way to upload files to MapTiler and track progress.
items.author: MapTiler (Jaroslav Polacek)

items.title: FOSS4G Europe 2025: Learning, listening, & connecting
items.summary: Find out what the MapTiler Team did at the FOSS4G Europe 2025 conference in Mostar.
items.author: MapTiler (Tom Armitage)

items.title: New High-Resolution Satellite and Aerial Imagery: USA (Florida), Luxembourg, Prague, and Slovenia
items.summary: Integrate crisp raster map tiles and ultra-sharp imagery layers into your web and mobile applications. Stream global basemaps with fast WMTS and XYZ API access.
items.author: MapTiler (Robert Slizik)

items.title: Demystifying Postcodes and ZIP Codes
items.summary: Learn about global postal geography. Discover how ZIP codes and postcodes work worldwide, explore custom developer formats, and learn how to map address data.
items.author: MapTiler (Matea Topolovac)
